name: Appledore Cottages
accommodation: Five properties: Myrtle Cottage (4 bed), Gannets Annexe (2 bed), Rose Cottage (4 bed, up to 10), Bimbo's Cottage (2 bed, up to 8) and Sea View Cottage
suitableFor: Families, large groups (Myrtle and Gannets can be joined) and dog owners
parking: Myrtle Cottage has a driveway for 3-4 cars; others not stated
beachAccess: Bimbo's Cottage is on Irsha Street near Appledore beach; Rose Cottage is a few level steps from the quay
confirmedFeatures: Walled and enclosed gardens, open fireplace (Rose Cottage), en-suite bathrooms (Bimbo's), linkable units for large groups
overview: A local business letting a handful of cottages around Appledore, from a two-bedroom annexe to four-bedroom houses that can be combined for large groups. Properties include one on Irsha Street near the beach and another a few steps from the quay, and pets are welcome.
surfTripFit: Options for big groups, plus driveway parking at Myrtle Cottage, suit a crew travelling with several boards; Westward Ho! is close by.
